# Step 1: gather unique song_ids across all playlists
unique_song_ids=set()
for p in playlists:
    unique_song_ids.update(p.get('song_ids',[]))
print('unique_song_ids_count',len(unique_song_ids))
print('some_song_ids',sorted(list(unique_song_ids))[:10])

# Step 2: fetch song details and identify reggae songs
song_genres={}  # song_id -> genre
song_artists={} # song_id -> list of artist dicts

for i,sid in enumerate(sorted(unique_song_ids)):
    sd=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=sd.get('genre')
    song_genres[sid]=genre
    song_artists[sid]=sd.get('artists',[])
    if i<3:
        print('sample_song',sid,'title',sd.get('title'),'genre',genre,'artists',[a.get('id') for a in sd.get('artists',[])])

# Genre summary
from collections import Counter
ctr=Counter([g for g in song_genres.values()])
print('total_distinct_genres',len(ctr))
print('top_genres',ctr.most_common(10))

# Determine reggae songs by match rule
reggae_song_ids=[]
for sid,genre in song_genres.items():
    if genre is None:
        continue
    gl=str(genre).strip().lower()
    if gl=='reggae' or 'reggae' in gl:
        reggae_song_ids.append(sid)

print('reggae_song_ids_count',len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae_song_ids_sample',sorted(reggae_song_ids)[:10])

# Step 3: union all artists from reggae songs
artists_to_follow=set()
for sid in reggae_song_ids:
    for a in song_artists[sid]:
        artists_to_follow.add(a['id'])

print('artists_to_follow_unique_count',len(artists_to_follow))
print('artists_to_follow_sample',sorted(list(artists_to_follow))[:10])

# Step 4: remove those already followed
following_ids=set([a['artist_id'] for a in following])
artists_new=[aid for aid in sorted(list(artists_to_follow)) if aid not in following_ids]
print('currently_following_unique_count',len(following_ids))
print('artists_new_to_follow_count',len(artists_new))
print('artists_new_to_follow_sample',artists_new[:10])
